style.register: 游戏指南体，简体中文，简洁直陈，不用敬语，不用『您』。
style.numbers: 数字、百分比、游戏内数值原样保留（如 10%、+5%）。
style.placeholders: ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ 等占位符必须原样保留且不得增删、不得调换顺序；它们代表图标或链接。
style.markup: 不要输出 HTML 标签；保留原文的换行与项目符号结构。
style.properNouns: 国家、人物、舰名等专有名词使用通用中文译名（如 German Reich → 德意志国，Adolf Hitler → 阿道夫·希特勒）；Paradox 未汉化的专有名词可保留英文并加中文注释。
style.consistency: 同一英文术语在全站必须使用同一译名。

The below is ⟦0⟧ player suggested strategies for ⟦1⟧. Bear in mind, due to the dynamic nature of the game, it may unfold differently for other players.

Start building up your navy trough national focuses and army trough experience, Justify and declare war on Haiti so that you can steal it's economy for your own good, here comes the naval part, get a foothold in Cuba in order to form Antillean Confederation even further. After that with the manpower increased, focus the naval invasion in mainland-Latin America, starting with Costa Rica, which is the weaker out of all of targets. Now you can continue to take Latin- and/or South America. Try to coup Argentina and Brazil in order to weaken and later take them.

Regardless of which ideology one chooses to do in the end, there are few steps which should be taken if one enters into conflict with the United States or United Kingdom and whatever their respective factions for the playthrough are. Due to the proximity of their territory to the Dominican Republic and their large Navy's it is more than likely they will try to naval invade your island several times. To counter this it is recommended to have at least one or two infantry unit focusing on HP, Entrenchment, and Defensive values at all times on top of the port. To provide a further defensive bonus on the port tile and to minimize the amount of troops needed to protect your port, one should also consider building a naval fortification on the port tile. If you annex Haiti and form Hispaniola you should remember to do the same thing for ports in Haiti.
